name: Boston University Winter 2019

venue.name: [Boston University](http://www.bu.edu/studentactivities/about-us/)
venue.details: In the big gym on the first floor of the BU Student Activities Office building.

information: This is the second BU competition, this time with 14 WCA Events! The cost to compete is **$30** and the competitor limit is **130**. You don't have to go for both days of the competition, as it is set up to allow competitors to go to one or both.
